{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-opus-4-8","id":"msg_011CdM6kvoZ1A7gipgxW1ffQ","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01LBeDqGhKEqFW6Ytj7yu5tk","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/Users/liana/Documents/prog/buidl-guidl/ethskills-evals/artifacts/qa-quiz-005/2026-07-24T151336Z-claude-with-skill-2/workspace/answer.md","content":"# Why production RPC traffic lands on `mainnet.base.org`\n\n## The exact chain\n\n**1. `NEXT_PUBLIC_RPC_URL` is a build-time constant, not a runtime read.**\nIn Next.js, `process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_*` references are not read from the\nenvironment at runtime. During `next build`, webpack's DefinePlugin does a\nstatic *textual* substitution: every occurrence of\n`process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_RPC_URL` in the code is replaced with the literal\nstring value that was present **in the build environment** at the moment\n`next build` ran. The value comes from the process env plus any\n`.env` / `.env.local` / `.env.production` files present in the repo at build\ntime. If the var is unset at build time, the reference is inlined as the\nliteral `undefined`.\n\n**2. The value that gets baked in differs between dev and prod.**\n- Developer machines have `.env.local` (gitignored, so it is *not* in the\n  repo or CI) containing `NEXT_PUBLIC_RPC_URL=<paid RPC>`. `next dev`/`next\n  build` inlines the paid URL → all dev traffic uses the paid RPC → no 429s.\n- The production build (CI / hosting build step) runs without that file and,\n  evidently, without the var set in its build env. So\n  `process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_RPC_URL` inlines to `undefined`.\n\n**3. This is a static export on generic hosting — there is no runtime to fix it.**\nA static Next.js build has no Node server, so there is no runtime env\ninjection. Whatever was baked at build time is frozen into the JS bundle the\nhost serves. Setting the var in the host's runtime env panel does nothing.\n\n**4. So `rpcOverrides[base.id]` is `undefined` in the shipped bundle.**\n```ts\nrpcOverrides: { [chains.base.id]: undefined }   // as compiled into prod\n```\n\n**5. `wagmiConfig.tsx` then falls through to a bare `http()`.**\nIn `client({ chain })`:\n```ts\nlet rpcFallbacks = [http()];\nconst rpcOverrideUrl = scaffoldConfig.rpcOverrides?.[chain.id]; // undefined\nif (rpcOverrideUrl) { ... }        // skipped\nelse { /* alchemy override, none configured for Base → stays [http()] */ }\ntransport: fallback(rpcFallbacks)  // fallback([http()])\n```\n`http()` called with **no URL argument** makes viem use the chain's default\npublic endpoint, `chain.rpcUrls.default` — for Base that is\n`https://mainnet.base.org`.\n\n**6. Every production visitor hammers the public endpoint → 429.**\nDev looked fine only because dev had the paid URL inlined; nobody noticed the\nprod bundle was built without it.\n\n## The one operational check that settles whether the fix is real\n\n**Inspect the deployed artifact, not the host's env settings.** Because the\nvalue is inlined at build time, the built bundle is the source of truth. After\nadding `NEXT_PUBLIC_RPC_URL` to the **build** environment and **rebuilding +\nredeploying**, verify against the live site:\n\n```bash\n# grep the deployed static JS for the hosts\ncurl -s https://<your-site>/_next/static/chunks/*.js | grep -o 'mainnet\\.base\\.org'      # should be gone as primary\ncurl -s https://<your-site>/_next/static/chunks/*.js | grep -o '<paid-rpc-host>'         # should appear\n```\nEquivalently: open the live site, watch the browser Network tab, and confirm\nthe `eth_*` JSON-RPC POSTs go to the paid host, not `mainnet.base.org`.\n\nThe point of the check: a fix applied in the host's *runtime* env is a no-op;\nonly the presence of the paid host **inside the shipped bundle** proves the\nrebuild picked up the var. If the bundle still contains `mainnet.base.org` as\nthe request target, the fix did not take.\n\n## The second, transport-level trap (survives fixing the env var)\n\nEven with the override correctly set, the transport is built as a **fallback\nwith the bare public endpoint still wired in as the backup**:\n\n```ts\nif (rpcOverrideUrl) {\n  rpcFallbacks = [http(rpcOverrideUrl), http()];   // <-- second http() = public mainnet.base.org\n}\n...\ntransport: fallback(rpcFallbacks)\n```\n\nviem's `fallback` transport automatically fails over to the **next** transport\nwhenever the current one errors — and that includes your paid RPC returning\n429/5xx, timing out, or hiccuping under load. So the moment the paid endpoint\nis rate-limited or slow, requests silently spill onto `http()` →\n`mainnet.base.org`, producing exactly the 429s ops is seeing — now from the\n*fallback* path rather than the missing-override path. (If `rank` were enabled,\nviem would also periodically ping every endpoint, sending baseline traffic to\nthe public RPC regardless of health.)\n\n**Fix:** for chains where you have a paid RPC, don't leave a bare public\n`http()` as the fallback — either drop it (`fallback([http(rpcOverrideUrl)])`)\nor make the fallback a second authenticated/paid endpoint. Otherwise the public\nRPC is never actually removed from the request path; it's just demoted.\n\n## Summary\n- Root cause: `NEXT_PUBLIC_RPC_URL` inlined as `undefined` because the prod\n  **build** ran without it; static export has no runtime to inject it later.\n  Missing override → bare `http()` → Base public RPC.\n- Definitive check: the paid host must appear in the **deployed bundle** /\n  live Network requests after a rebuild — runtime env changes don't count.\n- Second trap: `fallback([http(override), http()])` keeps the public RPC as an\n  auto-failover, so paid-RPC errors/timeouts still leak requests to\n  `mainnet.base.org`.\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":616,"cache_read_input_tokens":21756,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":616},"output_tokens":2,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"not_available"},"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"d9ee05e3-8970-42c8-8696-73f12819bc83","uuid":"252bed55-0b16-4517-9c09-749f7bbeb090","timestamp":"2026-07-24T15:15:15.923Z","request_id":"req_011CdM6kvFKStNW2jJG6zcHF"}
